comments:
The title suggests a report of Atiśa's (ID:3745) teaching on the eight topics of the Abhisamayālaṃkāra (ID:3706).
In (ID:5174), the portion explaining the eight topics covers fol. 37a1-61b4, ending with "rdzogs so" and is followed, up to 62b4, by a  summarized explanation (don brgyad du bstan pa'i gdam ngag la spyir bsdus don gyi tshul du rnam par bshad pa) which starts with "da ni" and ends with "jo bo rje'i gdams pa rdzogs s+h+hyo."

The contents of the first third of the text is more tied to Madhyamaka than Perfection of wisdom, and includes digressions about the perspectives of the "hearers" (nyan thos), "idealists" (sems tsam), and Madhyamaka (dbu ma) and a refutation of idealism. The author uses tools and vocabulary of epistemology (e.g., gnod pa'i tshad ma, lhan cig mi gnas pa'i 'gal ba), but refutes perception and inference being valid cognitions (fol. 42). 
New sections start with the expression "da ni."

The views of other scholars, who are not named, are mentioned about 10 times (often with the expression "kha cig dag di ltar sems ste).
